impactedRelations.description:
The relations that were impacted by the {@link FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob#updatedSensors}.
See {@link FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob#map} for more details.

sourceOfTruthModel.description:
The [source of truth](FaultySensor.RiskModelSourceOfTruthRelation) model for the specific
[model](ReliabilityRiskMlModel). The model is the one with ID equal the the key in the result from
{@link FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob#map}.

sensorToImpactedRelations.description:
A map of {@link Sensor} ids to the #impactedRelations. This is used for generating notifications in
{@link FaultySensor.Notification}.

title:
An intermediate type in the {@link FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob}. The key is the ID of the model
that all #impactedRelations are related to.

This type is the result of identifying which relations are impacted by {@link Sensor}s becoming faulty or
operational.
name: FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob.InterValType
